title: 第21章 重拾斗志的唐山赤霄剑阁遇灭顶之灾第22章 再见唐山
lines: 将白云帝救下，太上皇目中流露出愤怒色彩，飞至看台上，掠过主位的顾云，看向瑟瑟发抖的青云和尚。
“秃驴？你们寺里那老秃驴呢？这事情一开始是你们这帮家伙惹出来的，结果你却在这里不出手？是不是得给我一个解释？！”
青云和尚讪讪笑道：“前辈，这你们合体境之间的战斗，我一个小小的炼虚境修士就不掺和进去了吧。”
“至于无我大师，他最近在闭关中，就算是我也联系不上他。”
“哼！”太上皇拂袖，忽地看到一旁坐着的顾云：“你又是何人？一个小辈……”
他话还没说完，就被重伤的白云帝捂住了嘴。
“嘿嘿，神子殿下，我父亲有眼不识泰山，老糊涂了，您别和他一般见识。”
顾云瞟了他一眼，并不在乎。
而是摸着小猫咪，问道：“现在去灭了赤霄剑阁，你觉得怎么样？”
舞月婵浑身一颤，看向顾云，眼中充斥着感动，亲昵的蹭了蹭顾云的身体。
“喵，呜呜呜，还是坏家伙最好了。”
“走吧，跟上。”顾云起身，带着风云韵离开。
“逆子，你拦着我做什么！”白云太上皇怒火中烧，自己好不容易将对方从敌人手中救下，现在竟然敢让自己丢面子？
简直是白养这个废物了。
“不是，父皇，小心祸从口出啊，那位可是上界来的，二十岁就达到炼虚巅峰的高手。”
“我怕您这老胳膊老腿的……”
“我呸！你拦着我做什么？公子要替天行道灭掉赤霄剑阁，我白炽当然要做马前卒！”
“逆子滚回去养伤，你爹我去去就回！”
“公子，等一下老奴啊——”
“牛逼。”白云帝看着父亲那不值钱的模样，心中比了一个大拇指。
一处山洞之中。
唐日天捂着自己的腰部，大口大口喘着气。
“该死，一个都没有留下来啊，到底是哪个混蛋！”
他语气极其凝重，他虽然是合体境的强者，而且战力不弱，但是浑身上下到处都是暗伤。
现在被那神秘强者偷袭，腰部受到重击，更是雪上加霜。
唐山呆呆的看着许久未见的父亲，不知道开口应该说些什么。
“父亲，您去哪里了，这些年为什么……还有您的实力……”
太多话想说，一时间竟不知道从何处说起。
“爹的事情之后再和你说，山儿，你没事就好！”唐日天捂着腰，很是痛苦的坐下，惨然一笑。
“那些该死的混蛋，竟然将你打成这样！”唐山愤愤不平，二打一也就算了，明明自己的父亲还占据着优势，那些大势力的人竟然还敢出手偷袭，简直就是一群畜生。
“无妨，小山，今日之耻你我父子二人必须牢牢记住，绿水青山，仇——一定要报！”
唐日天握紧了拳头，小山，我先带着你特训。
他虽然受伤颇重，但是指导唐山修炼还是绰绰有余的。
名师指导下，唐山的修炼进境突飞猛进，他还没找回舞月婵。
忽然，一个人影出现在了他的脑海之中。
“顾家神子？”
没有了生命之忧，一切都开始串联起来了。
金惜狂、炼虚修为、顾家公子，众人尊崇。
以及那一只，小猫咪？！
小猫咪！！
难道说——
“父亲，月婵她究竟——”
“你说那个我放在你身边的小女孩啊。”唐日天回忆道：“那是一只三命猫妖，当初我救下她，想着你之后一个人孤零零的，让她来陪着你……”
唐山脑袋中犹如有炸弹轰然炸响！
content_en:
After rescuing Emperor Baiyun, the Supreme Emperor showed anger in his eyes, flew to the stands, passed by Gu Yun in the main seat, and looked at the trembling Monk Qingyun.
"Bald donkey? Where is the old bald donkey in your temple? It was you guys who caused this in the first place, but you didn't do anything here? Do you have to give me an explanation?!"
Monk Qingyun said with a smile: "Senior, I, a small monk in the Void Refining Realm, will not get involved in this battle between you two."
"As for the Selfless Master, he is in retreat recently, and even I can't contact him."
"Hmph!" The Supreme Emperor flicked his sleeves and suddenly saw Gu Yun sitting beside him: "Who are you? A junior..."
Before he could finish his words, the seriously injured Emperor Baiyun covered his mouth.
"Hey, His Highness the Son of God, my father is too blind to recognize Taishan. He is an old fool. Don't be as knowledgeable as him."
Gu Yun glanced at him and didn't care.
Instead, he touched the kitten and asked: "Now that we have destroyed the Chixiao Sword Pavilion, what do you think?"
Wu Yuechan trembled all over, looked at Gu Yun, her eyes filled with emotion, and rubbed Gu Yun's body intimately.
"Meow, woo woo, the bad guy is the best."
"Let's go, follow." Gu Yun stood up and left with Feng Yunyun.
"Sir, what are you doing to stop me!" Emperor Baiyun was furious. He had finally saved the other party from the enemy, but now he dared to embarrass himself?
It's just a waste of time raising this piece of trash.
"No, Father, be careful of what comes out of your mouth. That person is from the upper world, a master who reached the peak of Xuzhou refining at the age of twenty."
"I'm afraid you have old arms and legs..."
"Bah! Why are you stopping me? Master wants to destroy Chixiao Sword Pavilion for Tian Xingdao, so of course I, Bai Chi, will be a pawn!"
"You son of a bitch, go back and recuperate. Your father will come back as soon as I go!"
“Sir, wait a minute, old slave—”
"Awesome." Emperor Baiyun looked at his father's worthless appearance and gave a thumbs up in his heart.
…
In a cave.
Tang Ritian covered his waist and gasped for air.
"Damn it, not a single one is left, who the bastard is!"
His tone was extremely solemn. Although he was a strong man in the Fusion Realm and his combat power was not weak, there were hidden wounds all over his body.
Now he was attacked by the mysterious strong man and received a heavy blow on his waist, which made it even worse.
Tangshan stared blankly at his father whom he had not seen for a long time, not knowing what to say.
"Father, where have you been, why have you been there all these years...and your strength..."
There is so much to say, I don’t even know where to start.
"I'll tell you about dad's affairs later, Shan'er, as long as you're fine!" Tang Ritian covered his waist, sat down in pain, and smiled miserably.
"Those damn bastards beat you up like this!" Tangshan was indignant, and it didn't matter if he fought two against one. Even though his father still had the upper hand, those powerful people actually dared to make a sneak attack. They were just a bunch of beasts.
"It doesn't matter, Xiaoshan. You and I, father and son, must remember today's shame. With green waters and green mountains, revenge must be avenged!"
Tang Ritian clenched his fists, Xiaoshan, I will take you for special training first.
Although he was seriously injured, he was still more than enough to guide Tangshan in his cultivation.
Under the guidance of a famous teacher, Tangshan's cultivation progressed by leaps and bounds, but he had not yet found Wu Yuechan.
Suddenly, a figure appeared in his mind.
"The divine son of the Gu family?"
Without the worries of life, everything started to connect together.
Jin Xikuang, Lianxu cultivation, and the son of the Gu family are respected by everyone.
And that one, the little kitten? !
Kitty! !
Could it be said——
"Father, what exactly is Yuechan—"
"You were talking about the little girl I put next to you." Tang Ritian recalled: "That was a cat demon with three lives. When I rescued her, I thought that you would be alone in the future, so I asked her to accompany you..."
It was like a bomb exploded in Tangshan's head!
title_en: Chapter 21 Tangshan Chixiao Sword Pavilion, which has regained its fighting spirit, is in disaster Chapter 22 Goodbye Tangshan
